_comment: Copy this file to config/roster.json and fill it in. roster.json is gitignored,
so real phone numbers never get committed.
Names here take priority over the macOS Contacts lookup, which is useful when a
contact card says 'Ben Work Cell' but you want the summary to say 'Ben'.
Handles can be written any way you like (+1 555-010-0001, 5550100001, ...) —
phone numbers are matched on their last 10 digits. Emails match exactly.
List every handle a person texts from; people move between numbers and Apple IDs.

people.name: Alex
people.note: optional — free-form context that helps disambiguate, e.g. 'trip organizer'
